note: Provisional launch progression based on stock car performance and character, not a measured lap-time leaderboard. Team histories are fictional Ultrack lore. Player XP and level rewards are not enabled yet.

saetta.story: A trophy-laden factory dynasty from Modena. Winning is the expectation, every season without a title is a reckoning, and Toro is always watching from up the road.

toro.story: A tractor works with a sixty-year grudge against Saetta. Naturally aspirated, over-built and loud, it has never stopped chasing the red cars up the Via Emilia.

corvid.story: The old benchmark, rebuilding its claim to the front. Precision and experience meet a hungry new generation.

mojave.story: Once a fixture at the sharp end, now chasing a revival with grit, inventive engineering and an underdog garage.

aurum.story: The reigning title holders. A formidable hypercar stable and the pressure of being the team everyone wants to beat.

liberty.story: A first-season outfit with veteran drivers, a track-only Ford GT and an ambitious supercar programme. No history to protect.

hayate.story: A Shizuoka outfit built around two Super GT-bred Japanese cars and a drift champion. Quiet in the garage, loud on the first lap, and sponsored by Sony.

norrsken.story: A Swedish hypercar maker that went racing in its first season with its own two cars, the fastest pair on the grid. Founder-run, quiet and exact: the speed is proven, the racecraft is not yet.

sarab.story: The breakthrough team climbing toward its first crown. Balanced machinery, bold racecraft and growing belief.
